title: Sri Rama's Contact with Jatayu
introduction: Rama and the other two on their way to Panchavati come into contact with Jatayu, the mighty eagle. When Rama questions about its identity, Jatayu narrates the creation of animal species along with humans, and informs Rama that he is a friend of King Dasharatha and would like to help Rama in exile.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे चतुर्दशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 14th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ पंचवटीम् गच्चन्न् अन्तरा रघुनन्दनः |
आससाद महाकायम् गृध्रम् भीम पराक्रमम्
verses.iast:
atha paṃcavaṭīm gaccann antarā raghunandanaḥ |
āsasāda mahākāyam gṛdhram bhīma parākramam
verses.translation: Then while proceeding to Panchavati that Rahu's descendent came across a mammoth eagle with marvellous might in midway.

glosses.meaning: Rahu's descendent, to Panchavati, while proceeding
with mammoth, bodied, with marvellous, might
an eagle he reached, came across.

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा तौ महाभागौ वनस्थम् राम लक्ष्मणौ |
मेनाते राक्षसम् पक्षिम् ब्रुवाणौ को भवान् इति
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā tau mahābhāgau vanastham rāma lakṣmaṇau |
menāte rākṣasam pakṣim bruvāṇau ko bhavān iti
verses.translation: On seeing such an eagle in the forest those two highly privileged brothers Rama and Lakshmana questioned it asking, "Who you are?" presuming it to be a demon.

glosses.meaning: highly privileged, those two, Rama, Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
स तौ मधुरया वाचा सौम्यया प्रीणयन्न् इव |
उवाच वत्स माम् विद्धि वयस्यम् पितुर् आत्मनः
verses.iast:
sa tau madhurayā vācā saumyayā prīṇayann iva |
uvāca vatsa mām viddhi vayasyam pitur ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: But that eagle with sweet ad soft words spoke to them as though to please them, "oh boy Rama know me as your father's friend."

glosses.meaning: to them, with sweet, soft, with words
me, of your, father's, friend , thus you know.

verses.devanagari:
स तम् पितृ सखम् मत्वा पूजयामास राघवः |
स तस्य कुलम् अव्यग्रम् अथ पप्रच्छ्ह नाम च
verses.iast:
sa tam pitṛ sakham matvā pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ |
sa tasya kulam avyagram atha papracchha nāma ca
verses.translation: Accepting that bird as his father's friend Raghava revered it, and he that Rama then asked for that eagle's name and lineage.

glosses.meaning: him, as father's, friend, accepting, revered
its, lineage, name, also, asked for.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुलम् आत्मानम् एव च |
आचचक्षे द्विजः तस्मै सर्वभूत समुद्भवम्
verses.iast:
rāmasya vacanam śrutvā kulam ātmānam eva ca |
ācacakṣe dvijaḥ tasmai sarvabhūta samudbhavam
verses.translation: On hearing Rama's words that bird said about his ancestry and himself, and in doing so, that eagle also narrated the overall genesis of all beings.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वकाले महाबाहो ये प्रजापतयो अभवन् |
तान् मे निगदतः सर्वान् आदितः शृणु राघव
verses.iast:
pūrvakāle mahābāho ye prajāpatayo abhavan |
tān me nigadataḥ sarvān āditaḥ śṛṇu rāghava
verses.translation: "Once upon a time there were lords of people, oh dextrous Raghava, and you may listen all about them from the beginning, while I narrate

glosses.meaning: once, upon a time, oh dextrous one

verses.devanagari:
कर्दमः प्रथमः तेषाम् विकृतः तद् अनन्तरम् |
शेषः च संश्रयः चैव बहु पुत्रः च वीर्यवान्
स्थाणुर् मरीचिर् अत्रिः च क्रतुः चैव महाबलः |
पुलस्त्यः च अ.ंगिराः चैव प्रचेताः पुलहः तथा
दक्षो विवस्वान् अपरो अरिष्टनेमिः च राघव |
कश्यपः च महातेजाः तेषाम् आसीत् च पश्चिमः
verses.iast:
kardamaḥ prathamaḥ teṣām vikṛtaḥ tad anantaram |
śeṣaḥ ca saṃśrayaḥ caiva bahu putraḥ ca vīryavān
sthāṇur marīcir atriḥ ca kratuḥ caiva mahābalaḥ |
pulastyaḥ ca a.ṃgirāḥ caiva pracetāḥ pulahaḥ tathā
dakṣo vivasvān aparo ariṣṭanemiḥ ca rāghava |
kaśyapaḥ ca mahātejāḥ teṣām āsīt ca paścimaḥ
verses.translation: "Of them Kardama was there at first, and afterwards Sesha, and later Samshraya was there with many children and a vigorous one he was. Then Sthaanu, Mariichi, Atri, the great mighty one Kratu, Pulasthya, Angira, Pracheta and Pulah were there. And oh, Raghava, Daksha, Vivaswan were while the other name of Vivasvan is Arishtanemi, and lastly the great resplendent Kashyapa, was there as Prajapati. [3-14-9]

glosses.meaning: with many, children, also, vigorous one
Kratu, also thus, great mighty one

glosses.itrans: pulastyaH ca angiraaH caiva pracetaaH pulahaH tathaa
glosses.iast: pulastyaḥ ca angirāḥ caiva pracetāḥ pulahaḥ tathā
glosses.devanagari: पुलस्त्यः च अन्गिराः चैव प्रचेताः पुलहः तथा
glosses.meaning: Pulasthya, also, Angiira, also thus, Pracheta, Pulah, then
of them, was there, the last one.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजापतेः तु दक्षस्य बभूवुर् इति विश्रुतम् |
षष्टिर् दुहितरो राम यशस्विन्यो महायशः
verses.iast:
prajāpateḥ tu dakṣasya babhūvur iti viśrutam |
ṣaṣṭir duhitaro rāma yaśasvinyo mahāyaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh glorious Rama, there were sixty highly renowned daughters to Daksha, thus we hear.

verses.devanagari:
कश्यपः प्रतिजग्राह तासाम् अष्टौ सुमध्यमाः |
अदितिम् च दितिम् चैव दनूम् अपि च कालकाम्
ताम्राम् क्रोध वशाम् चैव मनुम् च अप्य् अनलाम् अपि |
verses.iast:
kaśyapaḥ pratijagrāha tāsām aṣṭau sumadhyamāḥ |
aditim ca ditim caiva danūm api ca kālakām
tāmrām krodha vaśām caiva manum ca apy analām api |
verses.translation: "Of them Kashyapa accepted eight slender-waisted daughters of Daksha Prajapati, namely Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kaalakaa and Taamra, Krodhavasha, also thus Manu and even Anala also as wives.

glosses.meaning: eight, slender, waisted ones, has accepted.

verses.devanagari:
ताः तु कन्याः ततः प्रीतः कश्यपः पुनर् अब्रवीत्
पुत्रामः त्रैलोक्य भर्तॄन् वै जनयिष्यथ मत् समान् |
verses.iast:
tāḥ tu kanyāḥ tataḥ prītaḥ kaśyapaḥ punar abravīt
putrāmḥ trailokya bhartṝn vai janayiṣyatha mat samān |
verses.translation: "Then Kashyapa is gladdened and said to those young wives, "You all shall deliver sons similar to me and who can sustain the three worlds."

glosses.meaning: to them, girls ï¿½ young wives, in turn, said
sons, to me, similar, you deliver.

verses.devanagari:
अदितिः तन् मना राम दितिः च दनुर् एव च
कालका च महाबाहो शेषाः तु अमनसो अभवन् |
verses.iast:
aditiḥ tan manā rāma ditiḥ ca danur eva ca
kālakā ca mahābāho śeṣāḥ tu amanaso abhavan |
verses.translation: "Oh, dextrous Rama, Aditi, Diti, Kaalakaa and Danu have agreed for that, but others became unheedful of Kashyapa's words.

glosses.meaning: Diti, also, Danu, even, also kaalakaa ca[ manaa] = Kaalakaa, also, [agreed]
others, but, not, heedful, they became

verses.devanagari:
अदित्याम् जज्ञिरे देवाः त्रयः त्रिंशत् अरिंदम
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च परंतप |
verses.iast:
adityām jajñire devāḥ trayaḥ triṃśat ariṃdama
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca parantapa |
verses.translation: "Aditi gave birth to twelve Aditya-s, the Sun-gods, eight Vasu-s, the Terrestrials-gods, eleven Rudraa-s, the Fury-gods, and two Ashvinis, the medicine-gods, total thirty-three of them.

glosses.itrans: adityaam devaaH aadityaa vasavaH rudraa ashvinau ca
glosses.iast: adityām devāḥ ādityā vasavaḥ rudrā aśvinau ca
glosses.devanagari: अदित्यां देवाः आदित्या वसवः रुद्रा अश्विनौ च
glosses.meaning: from Aditi, Aadityaa-s, Vasu-s, two Ashvini-s

verses.devanagari:
दितिः तु अजनयत् पुत्रान् दैत्याम् तात यशस्विनः
तेषाम् इयम् वसुमती पुरा आसीत् स वन अर्णवा |
verses.iast:
ditiḥ tu ajanayat putrān daityām tāta yaśasvinaḥ
teṣām iyam vasumatī purā āsīt sa vana arṇavā |
verses.translation: "Oh, boy Rama, Diti gave birth to well-known Daitya-s, the so-called demons, and earlier this earth with forests and oceans belonged to them.

glosses.itrans: ditiH tu yashasvinaH daityaam putraan ajanayat
glosses.iast: ditiḥ tu yaśasvinaḥ daityām putrān ajanayat
glosses.devanagari: दितिः तु यशस्विनः दैत्यां पुत्रान् अजनयत्
glosses.meaning: Diti, but, well-known ones, Daitya-s [so-called demons,] as sons, gave birth to
this, earth, theirs, earlier, was there.

verses.devanagari:
दनुः तु अजनयत् पुत्रम् अश्वग्रीवम् अरिंदम
नरकम् कालकम् चैव कालका अपि व्यजायत |
verses.iast:
danuḥ tu ajanayat putram aśvagrīvam arindama
narakam kālakam caiva kālakā api vyajāyata |
verses.translation: "And oh, enemy-destroyer Rama, Danu gave birth to son Ashvagriiva or also called Hayagriiva, Horse-headed god, and Kaalakaa gave birth to Naraka and Kaalaka.

glosses.meaning: Danu, to Ashvagriiva or Hayagriiva, the son, gave birth to

verses.devanagari:
क्रौन्चीम् भासीम् तथा श्येनीम् धृतराष्ट्रीम् तथा शुकीम्
ताम्रा तु सुषुवे कन्याः पंच एता लोकविश्रुताः |
verses.iast:
krauncīm bhāsīm tathā śyenīm dhṛtarāṣṭrīm tathā śukīm
tāmrā tu suṣuve kanyāḥ paṃca etā lokaviśrutāḥ |
verses.translation: "But Taamraa gave birth to five world renowned girls namely, Krounchi, Bhaasii, Shyenii, Dhritaraashtrii, and Shukii.

glosses.itrans: kraunciim bhaasiim tathaa shyeniim dhR^itaraaSTriim tathaa shukiim
glosses.iast: krauncīm bhāsīm tathā śyenīm dhṛtarāṣṭrīm tathā śukīm
glosses.devanagari: क्रौन्चीं भासीं तथा श्येनीं धृतराष्ट्रीं तथा शुकीं
glosses.meaning: to Krounchi, Bhaasii, then, to Shyenii, Dhritaraashtrii, like that, to Shukii
world, renowned, to five, girls, gave birth.

verses.devanagari:
उलूकान् जनयत् क्रौन्ची भासी भासान् व्यजायत
श्येनी श्येनाम् च गृध्राम च व्यजायत सुतेजसः |
धृतराष्ट्री तु हंसाम् च कलहंसाम् च सर्वशः
verses.iast:
ulūkān janayat krauncī bhāsī bhāsān vyajāyata
śyenī śyenām ca gṛdhrāma ca vyajāyata sutejasaḥ |
dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsām ca kalahaṃsām ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "And from each of the five daughters of Taamraa in turn emanated are the other avian species, where Kraunchii gave birth to Uluuka-s, the owls, Bhasii-s gave birth to Bhaasaa-s, the vultures, and Shyenii gave birth to very sharp eagles and falcons, and then Dhritaraashtrii gave birth to swans and all other kinds of graceful water-birds.

glosses.itrans: shyenii vyajaayata su tejasaH shyenaam gR^idhraama ca
glosses.iast: śyenī vyajāyata su tejasaḥ śyenām gṛdhrāma ca
glosses.devanagari: श्येनी व्यजायत सु तेजसः श्येनां गृध्राम च
glosses.meaning: Shyenii, gave birth to, very sharp, eagles, falcons [or, raptors as the case may be]

glosses.itrans: dhR^itaraaSTrii hamsaam ca sarvashaH kala hamsaam ca
glosses.iast: dhṛtarāṣṭrī hamsām ca sarvaśaḥ kala hamsām ca
glosses.devanagari: धृतराष्ट्री हम्सां च सर्वशः कल हम्सां च

verses.devanagari:
चक्रवाकाम् च भद्रम् ते विजज्ञे सा अपि भामिनी |
शुकी नताम् विजज्ञे तु नताया विनता सुता
verses.iast:
cakravākām ca bhadram te vijajñe sā api bhāminī |
śukī natām vijajñe tu natāyā vinatā sutā
verses.translation: "Dhritaraashtrii gave birth even to Chakravaaka water-birds, and Shukii gave birth to a daughter Nata, and Nata's daughter is Vinata.

glosses.itrans: saa bhaaminii cakravaakaam ca api vijaj~ne
glosses.iast: sā bhāminī cakravākām ca api vijajñe
glosses.devanagari: सा भामिनी चक्रवाकां च अपि विजज्ञे
glosses.meaning: she, that lady, Chakravaaka birds, also, even, gave birth to

verses.devanagari:
दश क्रोधवशा राम विजज्ञे अपि आत्मसंभवाः |
मृगीम् च मृगमंदाम् च हरीम् भद्रमदाम् अपि
मात.ंगीम् अथ शार्दूलीम् श्वेताम् च सुरभीम् तथा |
सर्व लक्षण संपन्नाम् सुरसाम् कद्रुकाम् अपि
verses.iast:
daśa krodhavaśā rāma vijajñe api ātmasambhavāḥ |
mṛgīm ca mṛgamaṃdām ca harīm bhadramadām api
māta.ṃgīm atha śārdūlīm śvetām ca surabhīm tathā |
sarva lakṣaṇa sampannām surasām kadrukām api
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, Krodhavasha gave birth to ten of her self-same daughters namely Mrigi, Mrigamanda, Hari, Bhadramanda, Maatangii, Sharduulii, Shweta, Surabhii, and like that to Surasa, who is embodied with all giftedness, and even to Kadruva.

verses.devanagari:
अपत्यम् तु मृगाः सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम |
ऋक्षाः च मृगमंदायाः सृमराः चमराः तथा
verses.iast:
apatyam tu mṛgāḥ sarve mṛgyā naravarottama |
ṛkṣāḥ ca mṛgamaṃdāyāḥ sṛmarāḥ camarāḥ tathā
verses.translation: "Children Mrigi are all of the the deer, oh best of the best-men, Rama, and Mrigamnda's progeny is Riksha-s, Bears, a kind of antelope, and like that the Himalayan yak like species.

glosses.meaning: oh, best of the best men Rama
bears, Srimara-s, a kind of antelopes, yak like oxen

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु इरावतीम् नाम जज्ञे भद्रमदा सुताम् |
तस्याः तु ऐरावतः पुत्रो लोकनाथो महागजः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu irāvatīm nāma jajñe bhadramadā sutām |
tasyāḥ tu airāvataḥ putro lokanātho mahāgajaḥ
verses.translation: "Then Bhadramanda gave birth to the girl named Iravati and her son is elephant the great, Airaavata, the protector of world.

verses.devanagari:
हर्याः च हरयो अपत्यम् वानराः च तपस्विनः |
गोला.ंगूलाः च शार्दूली व्याघ्राम् च अजनयत् सुतान्
verses.iast:
haryāḥ ca harayo apatyam vānarāḥ ca tapasvinaḥ |
golā.ṃgūlāḥ ca śārdūlī vyāghrām ca ajanayat sutān
verses.translation: "And Hari's offspring are lions and sagely/mighty monkeys, while Sharduulii gave birth to baboons and tigers.

verses.devanagari:
मात.ंग्याः तु अथ मातंगाअपत्यम् मनुज ऋषभ |
दिशागजम् तु श्वेत काकुत्स्थ श्वेता व्यजनयत् सुतम्
verses.iast:
māta.ṃgyāḥ tu atha mātaṃgāapatyam manuja ṛṣabha |
diśāgajam tu śveta kākutstha śvetā vyajanayat sutam
verses.translation: "Then Maatangi's childrenm are elephants, oh, best one among men, Rama, and Shweta gave birth to eight elephants that are at eight quarters of world, sustaining the world on their head.

glosses.meaning: Shweta, gave birth, to sons, at quarters, elephants

verses.devanagari:
ततो दुहितरौ राम सुरभिर् द्वे वि अजायत |
रोहिणीम् नाम भद्रम् ते गन्धर्वीम् च यशस्विनीम्
verses.iast:
tato duhitarau rāma surabhir dve vi ajāyata |
rohiṇīm nāma bhadram te gandharvīm ca yaśasvinīm
verses.translation: "Then, oh Rama, Surabhi gave birth to two daughters, one is named as illustrious Rohini, safe you be, and the other is Gandharvi.

verses.devanagari:
रोहिणि अजनयद् गावो गन्धर्वी वाजिनः सुतान् |
सुरसा अजनयन् नागान् राम कद्रूः च पन्नगान्
verses.iast:
rohiṇi ajanayad gāvo gandharvī vājinaḥ sutān |
surasā ajanayan nāgān rāma kadrūḥ ca pannagān
verses.translation: "Rohini gave birth to cows and other livestock, while Surasa gave birth to Naagaa-s, viz., many headed serpents, while Kadru gave birth to ordinary serpents.

glosses.meaning: Gandharvii, [gave birth] to sons, the horses
Surasa, gave birth, many headed serpents

verses.devanagari:
मनुर् मनुष्यान् जनयत् कश्यपस्य महात्मनः |
ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् शूद्राम् च मनुजर्षभ
verses.iast:
manur manuṣyān janayat kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ |
brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān śūdrām ca manuja.rṣabha
verses.translation: "Oh, the best among men Rama, the wife of great-soul Kashyapa, lady Manu procreated humans, Brahman--s, Kshatriya-s, Vyasya-s, and Shudra-s.

verses.devanagari:
मुखतो ब्राह्मणा जाता उरसः क्षत्रियाः तथा |
ऊरुभ्याम् जज्ञिरे वैश्याः पद्भ्याम् शूद्रा इति श्रुतिः
verses.iast:
mukhato brāhmaṇā jātā urasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ tathā |
ūrubhyām jajñire vaiśyāḥ padbhyām śūdrā iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: "The Brahman-s emerged from face, the Kshatriya-s from chest, the Vyasya-s from two thighs, and the Shudra-s from two feet, thus we hear from the scriptures viz., Veda, i.e., Rig Veda Purusha Shuukta.

glosses.meaning: from two thighs, came out, Vyasya-s

verses.devanagari:
सर्वान् पुण्य फलान् वृक्षान् अनला अपि व्यजायत |
विनता च शुकी पौत्री कद्रूः च सुरसा स्वसा
verses.iast:
sarvān puṇya phalān vṛkṣān analā api vyajāyata |
vinatā ca śukī pautrī kadrūḥ ca surasā svasā
verses.translation: "All the merited fruit-bearing trees are given birth by Anala, and now I will narrate about Vinata, the daughter's daughter of Shukii, and about Kadru, the sister of Surasa.

glosses.meaning: Vinata, also, Shuki's, grand daughter [daughter's daughter]

verses.devanagari:
कद्रूर् नाग सहस्रम् तु विजज्ञे धरणीधरन् |
द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायाः तु गरुडो अरुण एव च
verses.iast:
kadrūr nāga sahasram tu vijajñe dharaṇīdharan |
dvau putrau vinatāyāḥ tu garuḍo aruṇa eva ca
verses.translation: "Kadru gave birth to a thousand-headed serpent who is the bearer of this earth, and Vinata gave birth to two sons namely Garuda and Aruna.
notes: Garuda is the eagle-vehicle of Lord Vishnu, while Aruna, also called Anuuru, for he is a thigh-less being, is the charioteer of Sun's seven-horse chariot. The seven horses of Sun's chariot are the seven colours in vibgyor as in a rainbow. Aruna and Garuda are of avian origination and attributed to be the speediest propellers, and Jatayu and Sampati belong to that lineage.

glosses.meaning: earth, bearer -- one who can bear the earth
Garuda and AruNa, also, like that

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात् जातो अहम् अरुणात् संपातिः च मम अग्रजः |
जटायुर् इति माम् विद्धि श्येनी पुत्रम् अरिंदम
verses.iast:
tasmāt jāto aham aruṇāt sampātiḥ ca mama agrajaḥ |
jaṭāyur iti mām viddhi śyenī putram arindama
verses.translation: "Oh enemy-destroyer Rama, I took birth from that Aruna, the charioteer of Sun, and my elder brother Sampati too, hence know me as Jatayu, the son of Shyenii.

glosses.meaning: from that lineage / from him, from Aruna/Anuura

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् वास सहायः ते भविष्यामि यदि इच्छ्हसि |
इदम् दुर्गम् हि कान्तारम् मृग राक्षस सेवितम्
सीताम् च तात रक्षिष्ये त्वयि याते सलक्ष्मणे
verses.iast:
so aham vāsa sahāyaḥ te bhaviṣyāmi yadi icchhasi |
idam durgam hi kāntāram mṛga rākśasa sevitam
sītām ca tāta rakṣiṣye tvayi yāte salakṣmaṇe
verses.translation: "Such as I am, I can be your helpmate at your residence if only you wish me to... oh, boy, this impassable forest is a beloved one to predators and demons, isn't it... as such I can take care of Seetha if you and Lakshmana go out..." Thus Jatayu said to Rama.

glosses.meaning: your, at residence, as helpmate, I can be
by predators, demons, beloved to, isn't it
with Lakshmana, on your, going out

verses.devanagari:
जटायुषम् तु प्रतिपूज्य राघवो
मुदा परिष्वज्य च सन्नतो अभवत् |
पितुर् हि शुश्राव सखित्वम् आत्मवान्
जटायुषा संकथितम् पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
jaṭāyuṣam tu pratipūjya rāghavo
mudā pariṣvajya ca sannato abhavat |
pitur hi śuśrāva sakhitvam ātmavān
jaṭāyuṣā saṅkathitam punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Raghava revered Jatayu in his turn by gladly hugging and stood by him with his head bent, and that kind-natured Rama is indeed regardful of the friendship of his father with Jatayu that is repeatedly said by Jatayu.

glosses.meaning: by Jatayu, again, again well, narrated
father's, friendship, heard of [he is regardful,] indeed.

verses.devanagari:
स तत्र सीताम् परिदाय मैथिलीम्
सह एव तेन अतिबलेन पक्षिणा |
जगाम ताम् पंचवटीम् सलक्ष्मणो
रिपून् दिधक्षन् शलभान् इव अनलः
verses.iast:
sa tatra sītām paridāya maithilīm
saha eva tena atibalena pakṣiṇā |
jagāma tām paṃcavaṭīm salakṣmaṇo
ripūn didhakṣan śalabhān iva analaḥ
verses.translation: He that Rama took the princess from Mithila Seetha, and proceeded to Panchavati along with that very mighty bird and Lakshmana, as though to incinerate enemies, like fire that burns down grasshoppers.

glosses.meaning: he that Rama, Maithili's, Seetha, on taking

glosses.itrans: ati balena tena pakSiNaa saha eva
glosses.iast: ati balena tena pakṣiṇā saha eva
glosses.devanagari: अति बलेन तेन पक्षिणा सह एव
glosses.meaning: very, mighty one, with that, bird, along with, thus
